note: Evidence gap, not a negative verdict. Zero shipment rows were actually observed on any source; the ImportKey pages are paywalled JS shells that render no records without login, and the three secondary trade-data providers blocked access (403 / JS challenge). Therefore export_status and domestic_status are 'unknown', NOT 'none_found' — I cannot state 'следов поставок не найдено' because I never got a readable dataset to search. Declared HS 721049 (flat-rolled steel, zinc-coated) is plausible for a steel name but is unverified against any customs line. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figure found, not estimated. Legal existence (LLP registration, CIN/LLPIN) also unverified in this pass; registries were out of scope per instructions. Recommended next step: re-run with a working search backend and a logged-in ImportKey/Volza view, or check MCA LLPIN and GSTIN directly, before assigning any shipment verdict.
